To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
voltage mode control is easier to implement but compromises on performance while average current mode control is more difficult to implement, but yields better dynamic parameters and performance.
voltage mode control can be a good choice for a low cost design with a good performance, but that average current mode control yields a better performance, but is more difficult to implement.
average current mode control provides superior dynamic response and is the preferred method for this particular application.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis and design of a power supply for a vaporizer used for the analysis of volatile substances.
the design, analysis and testing of a DC- DC converter that will be used as a power supply for a vaporizer used by a spectrometric instrument.
the design of a digital controller for a DC- DC converter, with particular emphasis on the comparison of average current mode control versus voltage mode control.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
voltage mode control is more cost effective but average current mode control is more effective in terms of dynamic parameters.
the average current mode control algorithm yields better performance and is more suitable for the particular application, however it is more difficult to implement and more expensive.
the voltage mode control algorithm is the best option for this particular application.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we designed a DC-DC power supply for a spectrometric analyzer.
the voltage mode controller was chosen because of the simplicity of implementation and the fact that the dynamic parameters of the circuit were acceptable for the application.
the average current mode control was the best option for the design of the converter.
The main takeaway from our work is that
average current control is a better option when the converter is expected to be operated in a wide range of input voltages, and when a good dynamic response is desired.
average current mode control is more difficult to implement, but yields better dynamic parameters.
the choice of the control algorithm has to take into consideration the application, the available resources, the performance required and the cost.
